About us

Two perspectives.
A shared commitment.

Delta Zulu brings together Dave Shull and Agnes Cheung-Shull. Our outlook connects global business experience with a personal commitment to the enterprises, people, and communities we invest in.

Executive leadership & investment

Dave Shull

Dave’s career spans public-company leadership, technology, media, and business transformation. He has served as CEO of Poly, TiVo, and The Weather Channel, and held senior leadership roles at HP, DISH Network, and EchoStar.

His experience includes leading international teams, setting strategy and product priorities, building complex partnerships, and guiding companies through major transactions.

Global perspective & multidisciplinary experience

Agnes Cheung-Shull

Agnes brings a global perspective informed by journalism, business, and technology. Her background connects an understanding of how people and markets communicate with formal business education and technology expertise.

She holds a master’s degree in journalism from New York University and an MBA from the University of Oxford, alongside IT credentials from the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.
